cost_law: The Director pays only for the Claude Code subscription and existing DeepSeek worker usage. Every entry below must have verified_cost_usd = 0 for our actual use, or the component must be removed.

dependencies.name: Unreal Engine
dependencies.license: Unreal Engine End User License Agreement

cost_conditions.our_use: Producing linear, non-interactive video content (YouTube episodes). We ship no interactive product and no application that relies on Unreal Engine code at runtime.
cost_conditions.royalty: Per Epic's published terms, linear content (film, TV, video) carries NO royalty regardless of revenue. The 5% royalty applies to off-the-shelf interactive products past USD 1,000,000 lifetime gross, which we do not ship.
cost_conditions.seat_subscription_trigger: Epic's seat-based Unreal Subscription applies to non-game commercial users at companies whose ANNUAL GROSS REVENUE exceeds USD 1,000,000. Below that threshold the engine is free for our use.
cost_conditions.action_required_if_triggered: If the Director's company revenue ever exceeds USD 1,000,000/year, a paid seat subscription becomes required and this entry must be re-evaluated. This is the ONLY component in the project with any future cost pathway.
cost_conditions.confidence: HIGH on the royalty exemption for linear content; MEDIUM on the exact seat-licence wording. Epic's website blocks automated retrieval (HTTP 403) and no EULA text ships in the install, so this was established from Epic's published pricing announcement and secondary reporting rather than from the primary EULA text. FLAGGED FOR CHATGPT/DIRECTOR VERIFICATION.
